referenceFunction.includedProcesses:
Wind turbine tower, at site including manufacturing, transports, installation, replacements, decommission and waste treatement. Calculated for FU of 1p. Data are based on the IEA reference 15MW offshore wind turbine. The distance to installation port is assumed to be 80 km. Assumed lifetime is 25 years.
Main data source for material composition: Renewable Energy Material Property Database, REMPD (Cooperman et al., 2023)
referenceFunction.name: Wind turbine 15MW, offshore, tower
